reason: The text demonstrates collaboration between leaders and people of Moab and Midian. Balak (king/leader) sends messengers to summon Bilaam, the elders of Moab and Midian work together to carry this message, and subsequently Balak and these leaders collaborate with their people in preparing sacrifices, building altars, and conducting rituals together. The phrase 'זִקְנֵי מוֹאָב וְזִקְנֵי מִדְיָן' (elders of Moab and Midian) shows leadership coordination, and passages like 'וַיַּעַשׂ בָּלָק כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר בִּלְעָם וַיַּעַל פָּר וָאַיִל בַּמִּזְבֵּחַ' demonstrate Balak carrying out coordinated actions with his people and leaders in executing the plan.
